title: Beastwars, Furry Quake 3 Arena
author: dagthomas
selftext:
I had tokens to burn, and wanted to take on a childhood memory for me, Quake III Arena. But make it accessible to all my (now old) friends, so it would be easy for them to join in on a battle.

So I spent 10 evenings creating this, went from TCP to UDP traffic, learned alot about graphics optimizations and had a blast doing the project!

You can find the source code here: [https://github.com/dagthomas/beastwars](https://github.com/dagthomas/beastwars)

And you can test it out here: [https://beastwars.dagthom.as/](https://beastwars.dagthom.as/)

The server is in Finland, so you might have a bad time in regards to your ping if you do not live in europe.

Anyways, just thought it would have some nice building blocks if anyone wanted to turn it into something else.
